name: save-point
description: Context, cost and cache at a glance: a band above the prompt, a /hud pane with retro game themes, and Autopilot context notices

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: Prompt cache lifetime for the main conversation: auto (detect from billed cost), 5m or 1h

priceMultiplier.title: Price multiplier (default 1)
priceMultiplier.description: Applied to every list price (negotiated discounts or uplifts). Leave blank for the default (1)

usOnlyInference.title: US-only inference
usOnlyInference.description: Apply the 1.1x data-residency multiplier to prices

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warn % (default 30)
contextWarnPercent.description: Context turns from green to yellow (start thinking about wrapping up). Leave blank for the default (30)

contextOrangePercent.title: Context orange % (default 40)
contextOrangePercent.description: Context turns orange (pick your stopping point). Leave blank for the default (40)

contextAlertPercent.title: Context alert % (default 50)
contextAlertPercent.description: Context turns red (should already be wrapping up). Leave blank for the default (50)

contextCriticalPercent.title: Context critical % (default 75)
contextCriticalPercent.description: Context turns inverse red (well past the point to save and start fresh). Leave blank for the default (75)

bandSegments.title: Band segments (blank = default)
bandSegments.description: Comma list of segments to show, most important first; the last ones drop when narrow. Any of: ctx,next,session,model,last,limits,tools. Leave blank for the default

showRateLimits.title: Show rate limits
showRateLimits.description: Show plan rate limits when the session reports them

spendLimitUsd.title: Spend limit, USD (default 0 = none)
spendLimitUsd.description: Per-user spend cap; shown in dollars beside a reported spend_limit. 0 = none. Leave blank for the default (0)

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Master switch for Autopilot (context notices to the model, backstop, guard, effort hints). Once switched in the pane or with /hud autopilot on|off, that choice is remembered and used instead

noticeDelivery.title: Notice delivery
noticeDelivery.description: tool: append to the next tool result; tool+turn: also with the next turn's start, whichever comes first

spawnBackstop.title: Spawn backstop
spawnBackstop.description: Deny new Agent calls above the backstop percent (Autopilot). A choice made in the pane is used instead

backstopPercent.title: Backstop % (default 60)
backstopPercent.description: Threshold for the spawn backstop and compaction guard. Leave blank for the default (60)

compactionGuard.title: Compaction guard
compactionGuard.description: Turn automatic compaction off above the backstop percent, so nothing compacts unless you run /compact (Autopilot). A choice made in the pane is used instead

effortHints.title: Effort hints
effortHints.description: Heuristic effort hints in the pane; never sent to the model (Autopilot). A choice made in the pane is used instead

effortCheck.title: Effort check
effortCheck.description: Allow /hud effort-check, one small Haiku call on demand (Autopilot)

theme.title: Pane theme
theme.description: Look of the /hud pane: default (plain), zelda (The Legend of Context), metroid (Context Prime), mario (Super Context Bros.), deepsea (Twenty Thousand Tokens Under the Sea), minecraft (Tokencraft), megaman (Mega Context), castlevania (Symphony of the Tokens), doom (Knee-Deep in the Context) or fantasy (Final Context). /hud theme <name> switches and remembers

themePalette.title: Theme palette
themePalette.description: Text colors for light or dark terminals; auto follows Claude Code's theme setting

themeFps.title: Theme frames per second (default 6)
themeFps.description: Scene animation speed, 2 to 8. Leave blank for the default (6)

overkillHint.title: Overkill mood
overkillHint.description: Show the hero embarrassed when heavy firepower does routine work

sceneMinColumns.title: Scene min columns (default 40)
sceneMinColumns.description: Below this pane width the scene hides and only meters show. Leave blank for the default (40)
